column1: # openfga/language DSL semantic validation cases not run, with the reason. Tab-separated:
# case
# Never edit an expectation to make a case pass; list it here with the reason.
# server-accepts: the language validator rejects the DSL, but OpenFGA v1.22.1's
#   server accepts the JSON the transformer makes of it (cases.json, field
#   server: http 201). fga_write_authorization_model follows the server, so a
#   model OpenFGA accepts is accepted here too. The server's validateTypeRestrictions
#   and isUsersetRewriteValid (pkg/typesystem/typesystem.go) have no duplicate check.
# inline-expression: the model uses an inline condition ($expression), an
#   experimental OpenFGA feature behind the inline_expressions flag, off by
#   default. OpenFGA v1.22.1 with default flags rejects these models with 2000
#   (field server), as pg_permissions does; the language validator accepts
#   them, so the expectation (accepted) disagrees with the server
#   (research/designs/d-conditions.md, open question 1, decided out of scope).
# schema-1.2: a modular model (schema 1.2). OpenFGA accepts 1.2; this extension
#   accepts only 1.1 and raises 2057 before any other check (research/designs/d-per-model.md
#   section 8, item 11). The server rejects these with 2056 for a missing relation.
# upstream-skip: openfga/language's own harness skips the case (skip: true), and
#   OpenFGA v1.22.1's server disagrees with its expectation.
